page.title: Staff workspace.
page.body: Manage your public staff profile, guild operations, blacklist appeals, team applications and bot health from one place — with live bot-wide analytics for planning the next rollout.
profile.title: How the team sees you
profile.body: Keep your introduction current while Discord remains the source of truth for your identity.
profile.bannerHint: Use a publicly reachable image. Leave blank for no banner.
profile.linksHint: Add up to 10 links. They appear on your profile, not the team overview card. GitHub, Bluesky, Twitch, YouTube, Reddit and X links become full profile cards.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Tell the community what you do…
profile.visibleTitle: Show me on the public Team page
profile.visibleHint: Hide your listing without removing your staff access.
profile.footer: Changes apply immediately to your public profile.
rules.title: Stay consistent with Discord
rules.body: Your global display name and profile picture sync automatically, so updates made in Discord are reflected here without another form.
rules.editableFields: Bio · banner · links · GitHub card · visibility

card.previewCaption: Live preview, refreshed every 30 seconds · GitHub re-fetches the card instead of caching an old status. The card follows your Team page visibility.
card.statusHint: Turn this off to keep only your name and staff role on the card.
card.statusAria: Show my live Discord status on the card
card.markdownAria: Markdown snippet for your GitHub README
card.markdownHint: Clicking the card on GitHub opens your staff profile.
card.footer: Card settings save on their own — your public listing and README snippet stay untouched.
global.title: Global Niko profile
global.body: Reserved for Graphic Designers, Head Admins, and owners. Paste publicly reachable image URLs.
